messages.text: Why did you reclassify the equipment to capex?
Equipment above EUR 5,000 is always capex. No asset number, no capex booking.
When would you stop and ask for help?
In December this supplier may invoice twice. I hold the invoice and check whether it already exists.
What changes for the Czech subsidiary?
Invoices from the Czech subsidiary need a second approval before saving.

map.title: Process invoices with expert judgment
map.summary: Fictional training example: classify spending, check duplicates and obtain the required approvals.
map.teachback: Use capex for equipment above EUR 5,000 only with an asset number. Check this supplier’s December invoices for duplicates and obtain a second approval for the Czech subsidiary. Confirm or correct this process.
